claim: The fifth independent review proposed a barrier proof needing no solver. Writing the requirement that a local formula be nonnegative and reproduce every recorded linear coefficient as A w' = a1 with A entrywise nonnegative and w' >= 0, a row whose right-hand side is zero forces w' to vanish on that row's support, and 7,109 of the recorded ray values are zero. The argument needs those rows to have a non-empty support. This step tests that premise on every cell the project has built.
approved: the fifth independent review of 2026-09-05, amendment 2 of the linear-program verdict, recorded in ../../ADMISSION.md; this step is that amendment's first step, run before any solve
rows: one per extreme ray of each of the 2,199 cells; the support of a row is the set of edges whose lattice length is positive at that ray
allowance: one run of at most 15 minutes, single threaded; one checker run
